answer: Tie each identity's rewards to a linear vesting schedule that releases only ~1% per epoch over ~100 epochs, and let any later jury verdict of fraud claw back and burn the entire unvested remainder. Honest sustained output becomes a slow signal that accrues openly; a Sybil spinning 1000 clones must freeze 1000 separate full balances for the whole window at once and recovers nothing on any key a raven-eyed juror flags. The bitter yarrow of capital locked past the detection horizon is the real toll: strictly linear per clone, no early cash-out, no pooled reserve to amortize.
